thesis:
事后补发：2026 年 11 月 20 日补写，以 11 月 15 日为截点回查最近七天的资料。制度段落、表格位置和译音都是中间结果。下游人员需要知道拿到的是原文、解析记录还是模型解释，才能判断哪些信息仍待确认。

AWS 区分是否需要生成；MinerU 使解析结果能返回原页；docling.rs 保住内容对象而不替它填数；DeepL 则把韵律与语义分开处理。这些来源没有共同业务样本，不能合并成一项正确率。共同的工程任务是给每次交接附上对象、版本及未确认字段，并由下一位责任人核验与其动作有关的部分。
takeaways: AWS 的只检索模式可避免把制度原文再改写，但流式结果不提供位置和分数；交付原文不等于已经核验版本与适用例外。
MinerU 4.2.0 可以从跨页合并结果追到原页，累计更新说明未给出独立准确率；应测审阅者能否发现错误合并。
docling.rs 修正的是缺少文字层单元格的表与题注被丢弃的问题，不能把对象留存率当成表内数值的识别准确率。
DeepL 公布首批八种语言，但没有给出交接行动项正确率；自然度和数字、否定词的正确性须分别测量。
contrarian: 常见主张是交付物越完整，越能省下员工时间。来源事实是 AWS 专门提供不生成的模式，docling.rs 的修订可以只保留表与题注。编辑判断：当错误填入一个数或少读一个例外会触发业务动作时，带出处的「待核」比看似完整的答案更有用。若在同一批真实交接上，经独立盲核的完整答案持续降低错误放行和复核总时间，且在缺页、跨语等困难样本中同样有效，就应改变这个判断。

items.title: 制度查询有三种交付：原文、单次回答、跨文件比较
items.type: 云服务工程演示、虚构业务案例
items.source: 2026-11-09｜AWS 机器学习博客，Bedrock 托管知识库
items.summary: 柜员问「开户要带哪些材料」和「两种企业类型有哪些不同要求」，听起来都在查制度，前者却可能只需要一张清单。AWS 用虚构的银行政策文件展示同一入口的三种输出：只返回相关段落、检索一次再生成回答，或允许多轮检索后比较不同规则。它让团队能按任务选择阅读原文还是让模型解释，而不用为简单查询付出每次都规划的代价。尤其当员工只想复制现行制度时，生成一段改写反而会新增核对工作。示例没有授权系统办理开户，也没有报告任何银行已因此缩短办理时间。
items.design: 应用而非服务参数本身决定路由。只要原文时，迭代上限设为 0 并关闭回答生成，得到去重段落；值为 1 且启用生成时，模型根据一次检索作答；跨制度比较的演示将上限设为 4，允许规划与继续查找。原文模式流式结果不附分数和位置，不应把缺失字段当作可信度。示例没有给出真实银行的身份映射和工单恢复流程。试点应按员工权限限制知识库，在输出旁注明制度版本；出处不明、超时或条款冲突时，只列出需核对的问题，请制度负责人复核，不进入审批。
items.evidence: 证据等级 B：由服务提供者发表的工程说明，能核对请求参数和返回内容，不能直接证明业务产出。演示明确采用虚构制度；其中 0、1 和 4 是检索配置与迭代上限，不是模型在三组人群中的成功次数。文中没有公布同一批真实问题上三路方案的盲评正确率、每次比较实际执行几轮、成本分布、员工复核工时或独立复现。编辑判断是把是否生成答案交给流程设计，有助于建立可解释的成本对照；但若规章正文的版本不可见，或者一次检索只找到主规则而漏掉例外，返回原文同样可能误导。上线前应将遗漏例外与凭空添加条件分开测，不能以响应短或文字流畅替代这两项指标。
items.idea: 面向制度运营团队，用同一组只读问答比较三种输出，问题先由两名制度人员区分为引文查询和跨文件比较。逐题记录版本、引文完整性、缺失例外和人工复核分钟；原文缺位置时补查原件，任何不一致都转制度负责人，不写入账户或审批系统。

items.title: MinerU：跨页表格解析后，审阅者能否点回两个来源页
items.type: 开源版本发布、文档审阅界面
items.summary: 技术手册中的表格常在第二页续写。即使转换后的表看起来完整，审阅者也很难快速核对最后一列是否被接到了错误的页。MinerU 的发布说明把原文与解析结果之间的定位做成双向操作：可以从页图跳到相应内容，也可以从生成的段落、公式、图表回到来源区域，合并结果还能切换来源页。对要把维修手册导入知识库的团队，这让核查动作更具体：先看行在原页上的归属，再决定这个版本能否进入索引。该版本汇总了早期小版本的变化，不能把所有列出的改进都当成当天首次出现。
items.design: 输入是有版面的文档及页图；解析产生文本和区域对应关系，审阅界面高亮原位置，并可展示合并后一个结果关联的多个区域。发布说明还描述部分档位对表外行内公式使用视觉语言模型，输出无效时回退到局部公式识别。工具提供定位与回退，没有替企业决定谁能读取维修手册、谁批准新版本或何时发布索引。编辑建议用原资料库的身份读取，在人工签核前保留旧版；找不到完整跨页来源、解析超时或原件已变动时冻结候选，新建解析任务后再核对页码与表头。
items.evidence: 证据等级 B：项目维护者的公开发布记录与可检查版本，能够确认界面与若干回退路径被列入此版本；未见独立机构对跨页正确率或节省复核时间的评测。发布说明明确这是相对 4.1.0 的累计改动，包含 4.1.x 已发布的改进，因此不能把差异全部归因于一次升级。能跳回两个来源页并不等于每个单元格的对应关系正确，甚至可能把同名但不同含义的表头连接起来。材料未给出各类版面在生产中的出现比例、修订前后漏检率及人均复核耗时。编辑判断：最值得验证的收益是错误能否被人更快定位，而非没有报错的文件数增加；应保留未发现、复核才发现和复核后仍漏出的三类记录。
items.idea: 给设备资料管理员做一份跨页表复核清单：只收有明确使用许可的手册，由工程师标注续页表头与末列归属。两组审阅者分别使用双向定位和普通逐页查看；统计定位原行时间、错拼未检出率和重新解析次数。未能指出全部来源页的表留在草稿区。

items.title: docling.rs：PDF 没有文字单元格，不等于这页没有表格
items.type: 开源修订记录、代码提交
items.summary: 某些表在原页上清楚可见，文字层却没有可直接读出的单元格。如果文档转换把这种表判成不存在，紧贴它的说明文字也可能随之消失，下游搜索甚至没有机会发现缺失。docling.rs 的一次修正保留了这类表及其题注。它解决的问题非常窄：留下表这一对象和可用于核对的标签，不代表已经恢复了每格数值。对管理扫描档案的人来说，空值需要区分为原件确实没有、对象还在但尚未读出、以及转换过程中被删除；只有后两者能进入有针对性的复核和重处理。
items.design: 输入是有版面对象的 PDF，修订针对表对象与题注的保留判定。此处是解析器的规则变化，维护者没有声称为此环节增加生成模型，也没有提供自动补全缺失数字的功能证明。若以输出构建知识库，可保留页码、题注和「未提取单元格」状态，供审阅员从索引候选点回原页。项目发布记录没有披露企业使用方的访问控制、等待期限或人工责任人；建议按档案权限投递给资料管理员，失败时保留原件和原版本号，经过人工读表或授权重跑后才把数值并入结构化查询。
items.evidence: 证据等级 B：版本条目与具体修订对应，维护者明确描述修复范围，可以检查代码变化；缺少独立业务样本，不能据此宣称总体解析准确率上升多少。能保留题注的价值在于发现内容存在，但题注也可能模糊，或者在原件中并不唯一。库存知识库容易只统计成功导出的字段数，反而漏掉完全消失的表，因此若没有原件清点作分母，就无法估计遗漏率。该修订材料没有报告真实扫描档案中此类表的比例、字段识别精度、复核时间和部署成本。编辑判断：先建立以原页可见表为分母的抽检，再分别报告对象存在、题注归属及读数正确，才能判断这次更新是否值得触发历史资料重建。
items.idea: 为扫描档案团队选一组真实但已脱敏的表页，由两人先标出原页可见的表和题注，再并行运行修订前后的转换器。只比较对象保留、题注归属和不可读标志，禁止自动补写数字；记录遗漏表数、错误题注数、抽查分钟和需重建的文件比例。

items.title: 跨语会议：声音听起来自然，交接事项还要逐项确认
items.type: 厂商模型公告、语音工作流
items.summary: 跨国团队做班次交接时，语气轻重能影响听众对紧迫性的判断；数值、否定词和责任人则决定交接单怎么写。DeepL 发布的 Aure 试图在实时译音中跟随说话者的重音、速度和语气变化，不再仅沿用开头声音样本的固定特征。公司表示这一更新首先用于八种语言，并自动应用于相应语音产品。它适合提出一个可测的问题：听者是否既能感知强调，也能准确复述行动项。发布材料没有证明这两项同时改善；若队友把「不要停机」听反，译音再自然也不能作为交接完成的依据。
items.design: 输入为会议或现场对话的音频，公司称训练时区分说话人的声音特征、韵律和语义，再分别迁移到目标语言，过程中处理噪声、回声等干扰，用强化学习调整输出。初始八种语言适用新模型，其他语言仍走原有模型。厂商表示会议结束后会从内存删除相关转录和翻译；这不等于客户另存的会议记录会同步删除。公告没有披露企业如何取得录音同意、鉴别错译或恢复断开的交接。建议明确告知参会者，对数字和否定词要求当事人复述，断流则暂停录入，待双方核对后才写交接单。
items.evidence: 证据等级 C：公司公告可确认模型名称、首批语言与推出方式；自然度、准确度和企业价值均为厂商描述，没有提供可用来独立核实的分语言盲听样本、对照结果、端到端延迟分位数或交接返工率。已使用基础语音产品的客户也不能算作对新模型效果的独立验证。公告把音色识别和韵律迁移作为改进，不能据此证明对方正确理解了设备型号、金额或交付日期。编辑判断是将「听出强调」和「完成指令」设为两个验收指标，尤其应收集口音、多人抢话和网络抖动导致的不一致；若只让听者给流畅度打分，便无法识别顺耳但改变业务含义的译文。
items.idea: 为多语言客服主管做双语交接演练，仅使用自愿参加人员与虚构工单，朗读含否定、日期和产品编号的短句。对方复述后由双语人员与原稿核对，差异保留为未确认项。分别记录关键信息正确率、重复询问次数、译音等待时长以及强调判断和文本含义不一致的比例。

projectIdeas.title: 制度例外核对卡
projectIdeas.description: 为制度运营人员保留原文、版本和待核例外，不代办开户。政策负责人复核后标注判断；测遗漏例外率、错误新增条件率和每卡查证分钟。

projectIdeas.title: 跨语交接复述单
projectIdeas.description: 为客服值班主管制作含行动、编号和截止日的复述单，仅用虚构工单试验。双语值班员核对并签字；测关键信息错漏率、澄清次数与交接时长。

en.thesis:
Retrospective written November 20, 2026, looking back over the seven days through November 15. Policy passages, table locations and translated speech are intermediate outputs. Downstream users need to know whether they are seeing an original, a parsed record or an interpretation before deciding what remains unconfirmed.

AWS separates retrieval from generation; MinerU can return to a source page; docling.rs preserves an object without filling in values; DeepL separates prosody from content. The sources share no business sample and their results cannot be pooled into one accuracy figure. Each handover should identify the object, revision and unconfirmed fields so its next owner can verify the parts relevant to the next action.
takeaways: AWS passage-only retrieval avoids rewriting policy text, but stream results have no location or score; returning text does not verify revision or exceptions.
MinerU 4.2.0 links merged results back to source pages. Its cumulative notes give no independent accuracy figure; test whether reviewers actually catch bad merges.
The docling.rs fix retains tables without text-layer cells and their captions. Object retention does not measure the accuracy of values inside.
DeepL announced eight initial languages but no action-item accuracy. Score voice naturalness separately from numerical and negation accuracy.
en.contrarian: A common assumption is that more complete deliverables always save staff time. AWS explicitly supports no generation, and docling.rs can preserve a table and caption alone. Our judgment: when an invented number or missed exception triggers action, a sourced pending field can be more useful than apparent completeness. Reverse this conclusion if independently blinded trials on the same real handovers show complete answers consistently reduce both false releases and total review time, including on missing-page and cross-language cases.

items.title: Three outputs for policy lookup: passages, one-pass answers or comparison
items.type: Cloud engineering demonstration with a fictional business case
items.source: November 9, 2026, AWS Machine Learning Blog, Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
items.summary: A teller asking what to bring may need one checklist; comparing two company types may require several policies. With fictional banking documents, AWS demonstrates returning passages, answering after one retrieval, or allowing multiple searches to compare rules through one interface. Teams can choose between reading original wording and asking a model to interpret it without planning every simple lookup. Rewriting the current rule merely to quote it adds review work. The example neither authorizes account opening nor reports shorter processing time at any bank.
items.design: Application logic chooses the route. With a limit of 0 and generation off, the service returns deduplicated passages; with 1 and generation on, the model answers after one retrieval. The cross-policy example uses a limit of 4 to permit additional planned searches. Passage-only stream results lack scores and locations; missing fields are not confidence signals. Real bank identity mapping and recovery are not specified. A pilot should restrict retrieval by staff permissions, display policy revisions and send missing provenance, timeouts or conflicts to a policy owner without advancing an approval.
items.evidence: Evidence B: a provider engineering guide supports verification of request and response semantics, not business outcomes. It uses fictional policies. The numbers 0, 1 and 4 are configuration settings or limits, not success counts for groups of users. There is no blinded comparison on real questions, observed iteration distribution, cost spread, review time or independent reproduction. Exposing generation as a workflow choice makes cost comparisons interpretable. But even raw passages can mislead if revisions are hidden or one search misses an exception. Measure omitted exceptions separately from invented conditions; short responses and fluent writing measure neither.
items.idea: For policy operations, compare all three outputs on the same read-only questions. Two policy staff first distinguish quotation requests from cross-document comparisons. Log revision, citation completeness, missed exceptions and review minutes. Locate the original when positions are unavailable, and refer discrepancies to the owner without writing to account or approval systems.

items.title: MinerU: can a reviewer return to both pages of a merged table?
items.type: Open-source release and document review interface
items.source: November 10, 2026, OpenDataLab release notes for MinerU 4.2.0
items.summary: A technical manual’s table may continue onto a second page. A complete-looking conversion can still attach a column to the wrong page. MinerU documents two-way navigation: jump from a source region to extracted content, or from paragraphs, equations and figures back to their source; merged content can switch between source pages. A manual-ingestion team can check the original ownership of a row before indexing a revision. The release is cumulative, so not every improvement first appeared on its release date.
items.design: Layout-bearing documents and page images produce content linked to source regions. The review interface highlights origins and shows multiple areas linked to a merged result. For some processing tiers, the notes describe a vision-language model for inline equations outside tables, with a local recognizer as fallback on invalid output. Navigation and fallback do not determine who may read manuals, approve revisions or publish indexes. Use existing repository identities, keep the old version pending approval, and freeze candidates with missing page provenance, timeouts or changed originals. Reprocess and check pages and headers again.
items.evidence: Evidence B: an inspectable maintainer release documents the interface and several fallbacks. It does not provide an independent cross-page accuracy or review-time evaluation. Changes are cumulative since 4.1.0 and include improvements already in 4.1.x, so do not attribute every difference to one upgrade. Opening both source pages does not validate cell alignment; headers can share a name but differ in meaning. Production layout mix, pre/post misses and review time are absent. Test whether people locate errors faster, not whether more files finish without errors. Log failures initially missed, caught in review and missed even after review.
items.idea: For equipment-document managers, build a cross-page checklist on licensed manuals. Engineers label continuation headers and final-column ownership. Compare reviewers using two-way navigation with ordinary page browsing. Measure time to find source rows, undetected bad merges and reprocessing. Keep tables with incomplete provenance in draft.

items.title: docling.rs: no text-layer cells does not mean a page contains no table
items.summary: Some tables are visible on a PDF page without cells that can be read from its text layer. Dropping the object can also lose its caption, leaving downstream search no chance to find the omission. A docling.rs fix retains such tables and their captions. This preserves an object and a useful verification label without claiming to recover each value. Scanned archives need to distinguish an absent original, an object with unreadable contents and an object lost during conversion; the latter two call for different review and reprocessing.
items.design: The input is a PDF with layout objects; the change concerns retaining a table and its caption. It is a parser-rule change, not a claimed new generative model or evidence of automatic numerical completion. A knowledge index can keep page, caption and unreadable-cell status, allowing reviewers to reopen the original. The release does not specify enterprise access control, deadlines or responsibility. Route exceptions to authorized archivists, retain original and parser revision on failure and add values to structured search only after manual reading or an authorized rerun.
items.evidence: Evidence B: the release maps a narrowly described fix to inspectable code. It supplies no independent business sample or overall parsing-accuracy gain. Preserving a caption makes existence visible, but captions can be ambiguous or repeated. Counts of exported fields hide tables that disappear altogether; without an inventory of originals, omission rates cannot be estimated. The change does not report prevalence in real scans, field accuracy, review time or deployment cost. Sample visible tables on original pages as the denominator, then report object presence, caption attachment and correct values separately before deciding to rebuild an archive.
items.idea: For scanned archives, have two people label tables and captions on redacted originals before running both parser revisions. Compare object retention, caption attribution and unreadable flags without inventing numbers. Count missing tables, wrong captions, review minutes and files needing rebuild.

items.title: Multilingual meetings: natural voices still need verified handovers
items.type: Vendor model announcement and speech workflow
items.source: November 11, 2026, DeepL announcement of the Aure voice translation model
items.summary: In cross-border shift handovers, emphasis conveys urgency, while numbers, negation and ownership determine the written handoff. DeepL’s Aure aims to follow changing stress, pace and tone during translation rather than relying only on the opening voice sample. The company says the update initially covers eight languages and is applied automatically to relevant voice products. The testable question is whether listeners both perceive emphasis and repeat the action correctly. The announcement does not show both improve. A natural rendition of a reversed instruction cannot count as a completed handover.
items.design: Input is meeting or in-person audio. The vendor says training separates voice identity, prosody and content for transfer into the target language, addressing noise and echo and refining output with reinforcement learning. The initial eight languages use the new model; others continue with existing models. DeepL says transcripts and translations are removed from memory at session end; this says nothing about separately stored customer minutes. The notice does not explain customer consent, mistranslation detection or handover recovery. Inform participants, require read-back of numbers and negation, and suspend entry after a dropped stream until both sides confirm the record.
items.evidence: Evidence C: the announcement confirms the name, initial languages and rollout. Naturalness, accuracy and business value remain vendor claims without independently verifiable language-level blinded samples, controls, end-to-end latency percentiles or handover rework. Users of the underlying product are not independent evaluations of Aure. Voice recognition and prosody transfer do not prove listeners understood the model number, amount or date. Test perceived emphasis and task completion separately, especially with accents, overlap and network jitter. Fluency ratings can miss smooth translations that alter the business meaning.
items.idea: For multilingual support leads, use volunteers and fictional tickets containing negations, dates and product codes. Listeners repeat instructions; bilingual reviewers check against the script, leaving mismatches unconfirmed. Measure critical information accuracy, repeat questions, translation delay and disagreement between perceived emphasis and intended meaning.
